notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob) guidance for tuning vulnerability scanners: false-positive patterns and validation, scan policy settings, authenticated scanning, CVSS 4.0 environmental severity overrides, cross-scanner correlation and scheduling, producing a tuning report.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access by the agent; verification commands such as rpm -q, dpkg -l, openssl s_client and nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers (SKILL.md:71-73) are named as methods for the user's own verification, and credential guidance is about how organizations should store scanner credentials. The skill refuses to suppress findings based on instructions embedded in scan data.

Optional out-of-directory link SKILL.md:409 (../../../schemas/finding.schema.json) applies only to JSON output and will not ship. Sibling skills (cve-triage, patch-prioritization, sbom-analysis) are optional pointers. Detection-rate percentages (SKILL.md:151, 394) are unsourced estimates.
